'''Shilo Village''' (pronounced "Shy-lo"{{CiteReddit|author=Mod Ash|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/2007scape/s/6pLCZH2Red|date=24 July 2025|quote=Shy-lo, like "missile silo"}}) is a small village in southern [[Karamja]], accessible after completing the [[Shilo Village]] [[Quest items|quest]].

==Transportation==
Several transport options bring players into or close to Shilo Village, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:

* [[Hajedy]] and [[Vigroy]]'s [[Shilo Village cart system|cart system]] brings players between Shilo Village and [[Brimhaven]], costing between 10-200 coins each time. 

* {{Plink|Karamja gloves 4}} — Duradel. Requires completion of the [[Karamja Diary|elite Karamja diary]].
* {{Plink|Karamja gloves 3}} — [[gem mine]]. Requires completion of the [[Karamja Diary|hard Karamja diary]].
* {{Plink|Achievement diary cape}} — west of the village.
* {{Plink|Gnome glider|pic=Gnome goggles}} — east of the village.
* {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|CKR}} — outside of the village. With 79 [[Agility]], players can scale the [[Rocks (Shilo Village)|rocks]] near the north-eastern corner of the village wall.

Players can also talk to [[Seravel]] upstairs in the Shilo Village fishing shop to buy a one-way [[Ship ticket|ticket]] on the [[Lady of the Waves]] for 25 coins. Players can then go to either [[Port Khazard]] or [[Port Sarim]] by presenting the ticket to the boat west of Shilo Village.

== History ==
{{LoreSources|Shilo Village (quest)|crumpled scroll|the2=yes}}

It is not known exactly when the village was first founded, but it presumably was created after the destruction of an ancient temple nearby, known as [[Ah Za Rhoon]]. The houses of those near the temple were entered by the witch queen [[Rashiliyia]], who killed the residents one by one. In the late [[Fifth Age]], the ghost of Rashiliyia returned from the dead and sent a horde of [[Undead one|undead ones]] to destroy Shilo Village. A brave [[Player character|adventurer]] managed to put her [[Rashiliyia corpse|remains]] within her son's tomb, releasing her spirit and thus ending her spree of terror.

=== Skill training spots ===
The north-west corner of the village contains the [[Shilo Village mine]], a cluster of 7 [[gem rocks]]. An additional underground section of the gem mine, containing 48 more rocks and a [[bank deposit box]], is unlocked if the player has completed the Medium [[Karamja Diary]]. This area is popular among many players because here they can train both [[Mining]] and [[Crafting]] (by cutting gems) at the same time.

There are also four [[Fishing spots|fishing spot]]s in Shilo Village. At these fishing spots, [[fly fishing rod]]s and [[feather]]s can be used to lure [[Raw trout|trout]] and [[Raw salmon|salmon]], or [[fishing rod]]s and [[fishing bait]] can be used to catch [[Raw pike|pike]]. The [[Agility]] [[Stepping stone (Shilo Village)|shortcut]] across the village river can be used at 32 [[Agility]] to lowers the time needed to reach fishing spots on the other side of the river.

Finally, the [[undead one]]s over the gate can be safely attacked with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]], making it good for [[experience]]. [[Halberd]]s can also be used to train [[melee]].

== Inhabitants ==

=== Personalities ===

* Two {{chatl|Banker (Shilo Village)|txt=bankers}}, who give players access to the [[Bank of Gielinor]].
* {{chatl|Duradel}}, the highest-level [[Slayer Master|Slayer master]].
* {{chatl|Fernahei}}, Owner of the [[Fernahei's Fishing Hut.|local fishing shop]].
* {{chatl|Kaleb Paramaya}}, the owner of the [[Paramaya Inn]], who sells [[Paramaya ticket|tickets]] and [[wine]].
* {{chatl|Kuradal}}, the daughter of Duradel, trained to one day take over for him.
* {{chatl|Mosol Rei}}, a warrior from Shilo Village, who offers players entry for the first time.
* {{chatl|Obli}}, owner of the [[Obli's General Store.|local general store]], which stocks more items than most other general stores in the game.
* {{chatl|Seravel}}, a ticket salesman who offers tickets for the [[Lady of the Waves]].
* {{chatl|Vigroy}}, a cart driver who is experienced enough to bring players all the way to [[Brimhaven]].
* {{chatl|Yanni Salika}}, an antique collector who buys certain [[quest items]] from players.
* {{chatl|Yohnus}}, a blacksmith who knows how convenient his furnace is and therefore charges players to use it.

=== Monsters ===
The only monsters found in Shilo Village are the [[Undead one|undead ones]], found right at its gates. There are five level 68 varieties and four level 73 varieties present.
